newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka Jan-July tea crop rises to 148.4 mln kg.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka Jan-July tea crop rises to 148.4 mln kg.

text.p: Sri Lanka's black tea output rose 2.2 percent to 148.4 million kg in the first seven months of this year from 145.2 million in the same 1995 period, Tea Board officials said on Saturday.
Output for July increased by 10.8 percent to 19.5 million kg from 17.6 million a year earlier, they added.
Production of the island's high-grown teas rose to 45.4 million kg during the January-July period, from 44.4 million kg a year ago.

Low-growns teas, which fetched record prices in the early part of this year on heavy buying from Russia and Middle Eastern countries, fell to 68.8 million kg during the seven months from 75.8 million kg in the same 1995 period, they added.
